protocol.propagation: DiGAE: sum over Out with 1/(d_out+1), sum over In with 1/(d_in+1), ELU, 2 layers, dim 128
protocol.loss: BCE on positives, reversed edges and random negatives
protocol.fusion: trained: edge head on the fused vector plus a 0.1 weighted reconstruction of the 768-d semantics
protocol.readout_B: the trained fused heads, not a fresh head
